objective: Choose one natural, minimal, coherent grounding event for L000 without writing pages, dialogue, comprehension, exercises, or assets.
l000_kernel_rules: Use direct teaching interaction as the setting; do not introduce a village location, board, sorting task, label worksheet, or extra world state.
Use the smallest cast: Ninereeds and one visually grounded named interlocutor. Taro is available as canonical-person-taro-nakamura-v1.
The natural event is one greeting interaction in which an initially unknown participant identity becomes known and the exchange closes.
Do not introduce a third-person distractor merely to include OR. The story need not contain every L000 form.
Score only the stable-name relation actually grounded for participants in this event; the full lesson handles the remaining supplied names.
Keep visual representation constraints as safety metadata, not learner knowledge.
Use no learner-facing text in this stage.
required_output: One closed JSON object following story-kernel.template.json and copying required_input_bindings exactly.
decision_rule: Pass only if the kernel is one minimal natural event and clearly leaves nonessential forms to practice. Otherwise alarm.
